answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 30529 Country: Pakistan Title: I am a university lecturer. I have applied to my university for study leave with pay. The university requires a bond that the person availing study leave will serve for the duration equal to the duration of study leave otherwise he/she will pay two times(double) of the salary that he will get during the period of study leave. This "two times condition" looks me as if involving Riba(sood). Please clear whether this is Riba. Can I sign this bond agreement with the university? If not then guide me what to do. Please reply me as early as possible because in three days I am to sign this bond. Question: I am a university lecturer. I have applied to my university for study leave with pay. The university requires a bond that the person availing study leave will serve for the duration equal to the duration of study leave otherwise he/she will pay two times(double) of the salary that he will get during the period of study leave. This "two times condition" looks me as if involving Riba(sood). Please clear whether this is Riba. Can I sign this bond agreement with the university? If not then guide me what to do. Please reply me as early as possible because in three days I am to sign this bond. Answer ID: 30529 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 269/248/B=1432) It is not "riba". However, it is not right as per the Shariah to bet like this. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
